title: Jefferies sees valuation upside in select IT stocks despite muted growth forecast
summary: Jefferies has identified opportunities for further valuation gains in selected Indian IT stocks. While the sector experienced a sharp rally in October, growth expectations remain muted. Analysts suggest that lack of negative surprises could drive valuations higher. Infosys and TCS were noted for potential rerating, with target prices increased. The worst-case scenario involves stagnant growth beyond fiscal year 2029 for IT companies.

title: Stock Radar: PVR Inox hits fresh 52-week high in October 2026; what should investors do?
summary: PVR Inox Ltd has recently reached a 52-week high and is expected to continue its upward trend. The stock has shown over 40% growth over the last three months, signaling strong momentum. Analysts recommend targeting above Rs 1,600 in the coming weeks due to supportive technical indicators. Important support and resistance levels have been identified at Rs 1,300 and Rs 1,650, respectively.
